name: Icelandic Glacial
verdict: Brand of Icelandic Water Holdings ehf; since a 2023 recapitalisation its incoming majority shareholder invested through Liechtenstein-based holding company Iceland Star Property Ltd.
note: Cleeks GC partner 2026 (official water; featured on the players' golf bags). Private Icelandic company. Anheuser-Busch InBev took a 20% stake in 2007 and reported raising it to over 23% in 2011 (icelandicglacial.com press releases); its current stake is unconfirmed. No state in the owner chain found.
